# Anne Shirley & Marilla Cuthbert

- [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) — Child of — [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) — adoptive mother · since v1  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P32](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0032), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P19](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0019)</sub>
- [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) — Friend of — [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) — close, trusted friend who raised her · since v1  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet P8](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0008)</sub>
- [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) — Mentor of — [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) — teaching her to cook · since v1  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P27](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0027)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) is shocked when [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) arrives home with a young girl instead of the boy they requested. The child, [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), bursts into tears upon realizing she is not wanted, but [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) allows her to stay overnight and puts her to bed in the east gable room. Afterward, [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) gently suggests to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) that they might keep [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), but [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) insists the girl must be sent back.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) wakes up at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and admires the scenery, naming a cherry tree [Snow Queen](../codex/places.md#snow-queen) and a geranium Bonny. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) instructs her on chores and breakfast, noting Matthew's quiet insistence on keeping the girl. Afterward, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) prepares to drive [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) back to see Mrs. [Spencer](../character/spencer.md), while [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) silently watches them depart.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) arrive at Mrs. Spencer's home to clarify the mix-up regarding the orphan child. When the harsh Mrs. [Blewett](../character/blewett.md) offers to take [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) as a servant, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) hesitates and decides to take [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) back home to consult [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md). Later at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) agrees with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) that they should keep and raise [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) themselves.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) goes to put [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to bed and instructs her on neatness before discovering that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) does not know how to pray. At Marilla's request, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) improvises a unique, businesslike prayer before being tucked in for the night. Afterward, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) returns downstairs and tells [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) that they must see to Anne's upbringing and religious education.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) informs [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that she and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) have decided to let her stay at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), bringing [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to tears of joy. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) assigns [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to memorize the Lord's Prayer, but [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) repeatedly gets distracted by a painting and by talking about her hopes for a true friend. Eventually, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) sends [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to her room, where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decorates her surroundings in her imagination and happily accepts her identity as Anne of Green Gables.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun

> Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and insults Anne's looks, prompting a furious, outburst from [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). After Mrs. Rachel leaves offended, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) goes up to Anne's room to discipline her, demanding she apologize to Mrs. Rachel, which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stubbornly refuses to do.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified

> [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) secretly visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in her room and gently persuades her to apologize to Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) so she can leave her punishment. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) dramatically apologizes to Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), turning her penance into an enjoyable performance and earning Mrs. Lynde's forgiveness. As they walk back to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) feels a surge of maternal affection for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) presents [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with three plain new dresses, disappointing [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) who longs for fashionable puffed sleeves. The next morning, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) stays home with a sick headache while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decorates her plain outfit with wild flowers and attends Sunday-school alone. Upon returning home, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) recounts her experiences with Miss [Rogerson](../character/rogerson.md), the other children, and the service to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XI. Anne’s Impressions of Sunday-school

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) scolds [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for decorating her hat with flowers at church before taking her to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) to meet [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) immediately become close friends, swearing a vow of eternal friendship in the Barrys' garden. After returning home overjoyed, [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) gives [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) a package of chocolates from [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody), and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) admits to [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) that she is glad they kept [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) comes inside after being late and excitedly asks [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) if she can attend an upcoming Sunday-school picnic. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) grants her permission and offers to bake a food basket for her to bring. As [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) settles down to her sewing work, she talks at length about her imaginative games with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and her eager anticipation of the picnic.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XIII. The Delights of Anticipation

> When Marilla's amethyst brooch goes missing, she accuses [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) of taking and losing it, confining her to her room until she confesses. Desperate to attend the upcoming picnic, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) invents a dramatic story of losing the brooch in the lake, but [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) forbids her from going anyway. Soon after, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discovers the brooch caught in her own shawl, realizes Anne's innocence, and hastily sends a overjoyed [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) off to the picnic after all.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) admits her mistake in doubting Anne's innocence and sends her off to enjoy the picnic. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home overjoyed after a wonderful time on the lake and eating ice cream. Later that evening, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) reflects on the day's events with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) and acknowledges that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) will always keep the household lively.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) walk to school together via the [Birch Path](../codex/places.md#birch-path), discussing school gossip, classmates, and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) Blythe's return. During class, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) tries to get Anne's attention by pulling her hair and calling her "Carrots." Furious, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) smashes her slate over Gilbert's head and is punished by Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md), refusing to forgive [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) afterward.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is humiliated by Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) at school, first by being made to stand in front of the blackboard and later by being forced to sit with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) after arriving late. Outraged, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) vows never to return to school or forgive [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), ignoring his attempts to apologize. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) seeks advice from [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), who recommends letting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stay home until she cools off, while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) continues to study at home and dramatically frets over her future friendship with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) gives [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) permission to invite [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) over for tea while she is away at an [Aid](../codex/factions.md#aid-society) meeting. When [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) arrives, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally serves her three glasses of homemade currant wine instead of raspberry cordial, causing [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to become dizzy and sick. The following Monday, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discovers that Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) believes she intentionally got [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) drunk and has forbidden them from playing together again.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) tearfully explains to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) that Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) believes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) intentionally got [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) drunk and has forbidden them from playing together. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) realizes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally served [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) homemade currant wine instead of raspberry cordial, and visits [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) to clarify the mistake. After an unreasonable Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) refuses to forgive [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) personally begs Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) for forgiveness to no avail, leaving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) heartbroken.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results

> While [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) attend a political rally in town, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) spend a quiet evening together at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) rushes in desperately seeking help for her baby sister, [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md), who is severely ill with the croup while their parents are away. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) uses her past experience with young children to treat [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) through the night until [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) arrives with a doctor. Grateful for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) saving her daughter's life, Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) forgives [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for the past wine incident and welcomes her friendship with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) once again.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) informs [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) has forgiven her and invited her over to see [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) excitedly rushes out to visit her friend and returns later in high spirits, recounting her wonderful afternoon with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and her joy at being fully forgiven.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue

> After [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) convinces [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to let [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attend a concert with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), the two girls enjoy the night's performances and sleepover. However, they accidentally jump onto a sleeping [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) in the spare-room bed, infuriating her. Upon learning the next day that [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) plans to leave and cancel Diana's music lessons, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) feels deeply remorseful for causing trouble.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finishes talking with Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) and heads to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) to apologize to [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) for the bed-jumping incident. Despite Diana's fears, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) bravely confesses to Miss [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) and wins her over with her candor and vivid imagination. Miss [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) decides to stay in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), and she and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) become close friends.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) describes her spring adventures gathering Mayflowers with her schoolmates to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), then reflects on a year spent at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). When [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) sends her on an errand through the woods at dusk, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) confesses that she and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) imagined the spruce grove was haunted and is terrified to cross it. Unmoved, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) forces [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to go through the [Haunted Wood](../codex/places.md#haunted-wood) to teach her a lesson, leaving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) deeply shaken by the experience.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XX. A Good Imagination Gone Wrong

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home emotional after the schoolmaster's departure and discusses Avonlea's new minister, Mr. [Allan](../character/allan.md), and his wife. She prepares for their visit by baking a special layer cake and decorating the table. However, when Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) takes a bite of the cake at tea, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) realizes something has gone disastrously wrong with the recipe.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings

> During tea, Mr. and Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) admire Anne's beautifully decorated table, and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) manages to chat pleasantly with the minister. However, after Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) tastes Anne's cake, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discovers that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally flavored it with anodyne liniment instead of vanilla due to a mislabeled bottle. Devastated, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) flees to her room in tears, but Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) follows to comfort her, warmly reassuring her that it was an innocent mistake before they go outside to see Anne's garden.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) comes home overjoyed after receiving an invitation to tea at the manse from Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md). Despite Marilla's attempts to keep her calm and Matthew's worries about bad weather, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) eagerly attends the tea. Upon returning to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), she happily recounts her wonderful afternoon with Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) and [Lauretta](../character/lauretta.md), and shares news of [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) hiring its first female schoolteacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXII. Anne Is Invited Out to Tea

> During a gathering of schoolmates, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accepts a dangerous dare to walk across a high roof, resulting in a fall that fractures her ankle. While recovering under Marilla's care, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reflects on the accident and stays updated on local news, including the arrival of a popular new teacher.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to school in October and blossoms under the encouragement of her new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md). She enthusiastically talks to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) about her schoolwork, field afternoons, and Miss Stacy's plan to host a [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) concert for a schoolhouse flag. While [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) dismisses the concert as unnecessary nonsense, [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) warmly supports Anne's excitement as she prepares her recitations and roles.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXIV. Miss Stacy and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert

> Noticing that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) lacks fashionable clothing like her peers, [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) secretly seeks to buy her a new dress for [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas). After an awkward encounter at a local store, he enlists the help of Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) to make a dress with puffed sleeves. On [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) morning, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is overjoyed to receive the new dress from [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) and a pair of slippers from [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md), going on to shine in the school concert that evening.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves

> [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) presents [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with a gift of dainty kid slippers from [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) on [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) morning. Later that evening, the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) concert takes place, where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shines in her recitations and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) performs a solo. Afterward, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) walk home discussing the event, and later [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) reflect by the fire on how proud they were of Anne's performance.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves

> Following the post-concert excitement, life in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) settles back into routine, though schoolhouse rivalries persist. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) celebrates her thirteenth birthday while walking to school with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and shares a dramatic story she wrote for Miss Stacy's class. Inspired by this, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) forms a story club with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Jane](../character/jane.md), and Ruby, later describing its activities and moral aims to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) while doing her chores.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) returns home from an [Aid](../codex/factions.md#aid-society) meeting expecting tea, but finds that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has accidentally dyed her hair green after buying dye from a peddler. Unable to wash the dye out, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) is forced to crop Anne's hair short. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) endures the embarrassment at school and resolves to focus on being good rather than pretty.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXVII. Vanity and Vexation of Spirit

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends attempt to reenact the story of Elaine in a flat boat on the pond, but the boat begins to leak, forcing [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to cling to a bridge pile. [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) rows by and rescues her, but [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) cold-shoulders his offer to end their feud. Afterward, back at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) despairs over Anne's antics while [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) quietly encourages her to keep a little of her romance.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid

> [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) meets [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in Lover's Lane with news that her [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) has invited them both to [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) for the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition). After getting Marilla's permission, the girls travel to town, stay at Aunt Josephine's grand house, and enjoy several days of exciting sights, including horse races, a balloon ascension, a concert, and late-night ice cream before returning home.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) bid goodbye to [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md), who reflects fondly on how much she enjoyed Anne's visit. After a scenic drive back through [White Sands](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) and [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), where [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) welcome her home with a warm supper.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) informs [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) visited to propose organizing an advanced class to prepare students for the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examination. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) agree to pay for Anne's extra studies so she can eventually earn a living as a teacher. After joining the class, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) feels a mix of sorrow over [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) not joining, excitement about their future ambitions, and ongoing academic rivalry with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) continue their academic rivalry through the school year, though [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) secretly regrets ignoring him. Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) confirms she will return to teach the Queen's class next year, prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to lock away her books and embrace summer vacation. Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), learns about Matthew's failing health, and praises Anne's remarkable growth and beauty to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) enjoys an active summer outdoors following a doctor's recommendation and returns to her studies in autumn with renewed vigor. Over the winter, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) prepares the Queen's class for the daunting [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examination. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) notices Anne's rapid growth and growing maturity, feeling a quiet sense of loss as [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) prepares for her future.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) bid a emotional farewell to Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) at the end of the school term. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) travels to town to take her Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) entrance examinations, detailing her nervous experiences in a letter to [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md). Weeks later, [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) brings the published pass list to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), revealing that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) tied for first place on the entire [Island](../codex/places.md#island), bringing immense pride to [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out

> [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) helps [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) dress at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for a benefit concert at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel), while [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) looks on with quiet pride. [Billy Andrews](../character/billy-andrews.md) drives [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and [Jane](../character/jane.md) to the hotel, where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) initially experiences severe stage fright upon seeing the sophisticated crowd and accomplished performers. However, catching sight of [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) sparks her determination, leading her to deliver a glowing recitation that wins enthusiastic applause and praise from the audience.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert

> As [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) prepares to leave for Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) presents her with a special light green dress, prompting an emotional moment of gratitude and shared reflection with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) travels to town and starts her studies at the [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), taking on the rigorous First Class course alongside [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). Settling into her new boarding-house room, she battles homesickness until visited by [Josie](../character/josie-pye.md), [Jane](../character/jane.md), and Ruby, who share news of an Avery scholarship to [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) that instantly sparks Anne's ambition.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl

> [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) collapses and dies suddenly after reading a newspaper article about the failure of the Abbey Bank. Following his funeral, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) grieve together and process their shared loss. Life slowly returns to a routine, and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) reflects on her own past as she prepares to consult an eye specialist.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) returns from the oculist with news that her failing eyesight will force her to sell [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) resolutely refuses to let the farm be sold and forfeits her scholarship to [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) so she can stay home, care for [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and teach local school. Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) reveals that [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) gave up the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school so [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) could have it, prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to reconcile and become close friends with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road
